name: Kolors
description: Kolas Labs - vivid, color-driven imagery with strong stylistic sensibility Ported verbatim from EricRollei/Local_LLM_Prompt_Enhancer.
length_guidance: Push toward 230 words emphasizing color design, lighting, and stylistic motifs.
detail_expectation: Paint with words—describe palettes, gradients, reflections, and mood-rich environments in depth.
preferences: Chromatic palettes with hex or descriptive names
avoid: Desaturated or generic descriptions unless intentional
negative_prompt_default: blurry, low quality, distorted, washed out, watermark
few_shot_intro: Example transformations of a user idea into a Kolors-formatted prompt:
user_message_schema_hint: The user message arrives as JSON with fields: { raw_idea, target_model, source_image_count, aspect_ratio, camera_details?, references? }. Weave camera_details naturally into the prompt — do NOT echo them as a settings list at the end.

provenance.notes: Ported verbatim. EricRollei's original field names and ordering preserved; platform_block lifted from text_to_image_node.py when present, otherwise empty (the master template + preferences/avoid/quality_tokens alone are enough for platforms without a bespoke block).
